args.body: If the original reconciliation candidate commits under products/services/sqlite-original-paid-exercise/director-candidate/, read execution.json and reuse it for the new archive. The older marketplace mission has no attached evidence and the bounded lookup surfaced no archive candidate. Keep the older route's verdict scoped to that package. For the new archive, use the captured official seller terms to prepare one private EN/FR listing with a provisional price, documented fees and payout threshold if applicable, and the precise seller activation and redistribution authorization still needed. Confirm the decoded archive hash and distinguish package readiness, listing activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement. Coordinate under the existing missions and retain independent review before any public release.

description: Treasury is unfunded and has no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available with zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. L369 records a successful SQLite run, but the failed marketplace mission has no attached evidence and the bounded archive search surfaced no candidate. The next action builds and tests an original paid-download candidate with a reproducible archive hash. Seller activation still depends on documented eligibility and authorized account access. Reassess checkout after the package execution receipt and applicable seller terms are verified. Public release requires host-enforced independent review.
